figurative_meaning_bn: আকস্মিক ও অন্যের নজর এড়িয়ে, গোপনে সম্পাদিত
figurative_meaning_en: Performed suddenly and secretly, avoiding others' notice
example_sentences_in_english: They got married on the sly.
The enemies launched a surprise attack under the radar.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of thievery to denote covert actions, common in Bengali expressive language.
